# Function map (generated)

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/workflow.py render. Edit workflow/registry.json. -->

Which roles and tasks belong to each function — a view for people, not a new source. Mappings come from `workflow/registry.json`. What a task reads, when it runs and who must decide live in [stage-procedure.md](stage-procedure.md) (scheduling and required inputs), [product-layer.md](product-layer.md) (decisions: who decides what) and the manager's human decision points (`skills/sdlc/SKILL.md` Step 4).

`function` groups roles for display only: it grants no product writes, tool access or waiver authority, and a team may organise differently (an analyst may sit with product or with a data team).
